source.title: Identification of a novel small molecule that inhibits deacetylase but not defatty-acylase reaction catalysed by SIRT2
source.authors: Kudo N, Ito A, Arata M, Nakata A, Yoshida M

assessment: Retain substrate-selective SIRT2 probe, PANC-1 anti-growth/viability positive and separately measured HeLa BubR1-protein decrease. No demonstrated MVA rescue, normal-cell therapeutic window or niacin efficacy.

access_depth.continuous_main: Complete Introduction, Methods a-h, Results a-f, Discussion, Table 1 and all five main figure legends read through the Royal Society-provided full-text preview on ResearchGate. Primary PMC indexed sections corroborate key claims.
access_depth.figure_text_only: Publisher preview provides extracted axis/lane labels; exact panel-dose values below are text-extracted, not visually verified.
access_depth.supplements: No separate supplement identified in accessible article or Europe PMC metadata (hasSuppl=N); none read.
access_depth.primary_pdf: Not obtained; apparent downloaded PDF was HTML. Normal PMC/publisher routes challenged or returned403; BioC no result; EPMC XML500. No challenge bypass.
access_depth.deposited_data: PDB5Y0Z and ligand8K9 metadata checked; coordinates/diffraction not reanalysed.

identity.name: NPD11033
identity.type: Synthetic cytisine-derived compound, not cytisine itself
identity.inactive_analogue: RK-0310020; two bulky 1,1-dimethylpropyl substituents replaced by methyl groups

biochemistry.assay: Fluorescent acetyl-lysine peptide electrophoretic mobility shift, following a fluorogenic screen
biochemistry.replication: Figure 1: three independent assays; Methods: IC50 mean/SD from at least three independent dose-response curves
biochemistry.selectivity_panel: Marginal effect on SIRT1/SIRT3; no inhibition of HDAC1/HDAC6 under tested conditions, TSA active control
biochemistry.limits: No comprehensive off-target panel, no general claim covering untested SIRT4-7; precise HDAC-panel dose not recovered.

biochemistry.result: Lost SIRT2 deacetylase inhibition; extracted Figure 3 label IC50>50 micromolar
biochemistry.limits: No measurement of equal cellular uptake/exposure.

biochemistry.result: NPD11033 inactive even at1 mM; extracted Figure 4 label IC50>1000 micromolar
biochemistry.conditions: 20 microlitres;50 mM Tris-HCl pH 9.0, 4 mM MgCl2, 0.2 mM DTT;37 C for 60 min, trypsin development for 15 min
biochemistry.comparators: SirReal2 also fails to inhibit demyristoylation; suramin inhibits both deacetylation and demyristoylation
biochemistry.limits: Applies to tested substrate/assay, not all cellular defatty-acylation. Retention versus kick-out models are unresolved. Do not compute a universal selectivity constant from unlike assays.

binding.evidence: 2.0 Angstrom SIRT2-NPD11033 crystal structure; hydrophobic cavity and reported 2.8 Angstrom ligand-His187 hydrogen bond
binding.crystallization: 17 mg/mL purified protein with 1 mM ligand

cellular_arms.dose_provenance: Text-extracted lane labels; pixels not inspected
cellular_arms.result: NPD11033 increased eIF5A acetylation; inactive analogue did not
cellular_arms.limit: Cannot transfer the combined TSA/NPD11033 acetylation response to NPD11033 alone.

cellular_arms.dose_provenance: Text-extracted lane labels; pixels not inspected
cellular_arms.result: Dose-dependent BubR1 decrease with NPD11033, not inactive analogue
cellular_arms.limit: Not a PANC-1 BubR1 result; no half-life, acetyl-BubR1, ubiquitination, BUB1B mRNA or chromosome-segregation result. NA denotes nicotinamide, not nicotinic acid.

cellular_arms.dose_provenance: Text-extracted axis labels; pixels not inspected
cellular_arms.co_treatment: No TSA specified in this pharmacology arm
cellular_arms.result: NPD11033 and SirReal2 reduce signal; RK-0310020 does not reduce growth through 60 micromolar
cellular_arms.limit: Actual anti-growth/viability positive, but ATP assay alone does not distinguish cytostasis, per-cell ATP changes and death. No direct apoptosis, clonogenic, animal-tumour or survival outcome.

cellular_arms.endpoint: Genetic SIRT2 knockdown and ATPlite signal
cellular_arms.intervention: SilencerSelect siRNAs s22707 and s22708 using RNAiMAX
cellular_arms.statistics: Student t-test; Methods specify **p<0.01, legend prints **p=0.01. Exact threshold notation inconsistent.
cellular_arms.limit: Genetic phenocopy supports mechanism; no resistant-target rescue establishing exclusive drug action.

culture_and_vehicle.PANC1: DMEM, 10% heat-inactivated FBS, antibiotics, 37 C, 5% CO2
culture_and_vehicle.HeLa_culture: Not detailed in the read Materials/cell-culture paragraph
culture_and_vehicle.cell_vehicle: DMSO is labelled in extracted figure; final fraction and matching across all arms not specified

not_established: Causal role of BubR1 loss in PANC-1 growth inhibition
text_label_corrections: Study in-vivo inhibition heading refers to cultured cells, not administered animals.
Main Results cite Figure 5C for inactive-analogue growth comparison; Figure 5 legend places the concentration-response in 5E.

niacin_implication.supports: SIRT2 deacetylase inhibition lowering HeLa BubR1 is consistent with a SIRT2/BUBR1 abundance mechanism and makes substrate-resolved protein measurements important.
niacin_implication.does_not_establish: No nicotinic-acid intervention, no NAD-precursor-to-SIRT2-to-variant-BUBR1 rescue chain, no allele-specific abundance/function or muscle endpoint.
niacin_implication.direction: Neither cancer-cell anti-growth nor HeLa BubR1 reduction justifies a class-wide claim that SIRT2 inhibition or activation is always beneficial/harmful.

listings.availability: Quotation-only laboratory-use listing; immediate batch stock not established
Page states currently out of stock; possible custom synthesis

current_research_supply.identity_caveat: PDB 8K9 specifies hydroxyl-bearing stereocentre and InChIKey ITCUJNFERKWPKY-WMTXJRDZSA-N; MedKoo InChI leaves that centre unspecified (ITCUJNFERKWPKY-JCVDRHSJSA-N). No authenticated batch COA or stereochemical equivalence established; this discrepancy does not prove a supplier batch is wrong.

decision_reconciliation.disposition: Retain substrate-selective mechanistic counter-probe and cancer-cell viability positive, with separate HeLa BubR1-lowering result; no MVA rescue claim.

active_comparator.name: SirReal2
active_comparator.reason: Distinct actual PANC-1 active comparator retained; no SirReal2 BubR1 effect is inferred.

decision_reconciliation.suramin: Biochemical dual-activity positive comparator; not demonstrated cellular rescue in this source.
decision_reconciliation.RK0310020: Inactive assay control, not a therapeutic lead.

identity.catalog_role: current research reagent listing; not clinical approval or verified historical-lot identity

assays.treatment: SirReal2 concentration series; no TSA specified
assays.controls: NPD11033 active comparator and RK-0310020 inactive analogue in same experiment; extracted figure has untreated zero-concentration condition
assays.limit: Original pixels not inspected; do not infer apoptosis or normal-cell safety from ATP alone.

assays.controls: TSA-alone condition, NPD11033 dose series and RK-0310020; total eIF5A measured
assays.limit: Co-treatment evidence; not proof of equivalent SirReal2-alone signal.

assays.result: deacetylation inhibition without inhibition of tested demyristoylation
assays.limit: Do not generalize across all acyl substrates; original figure pixels not inspected.

bubr1.explanation: Figure 5B HeLa BubR1 arm tests NPD11033 with inactive analogue and nicotinamide, not SirReal2. Do not transfer its lowering result or vendor biology to this qualified SirReal2 evidence.

boundaries: No drug-treated animal outcome in this paper
NPD11033 crystal-binding structure and numerical cellular potency belong to NPD11033
No full figure-image or supplementary-material reading credit

independent_check: Root checked extracted primary Figure 5 legend and ATPlite Methods for cell type, timing, co-treatment and replication. No original image review or separate full-paper review claimed.
